thread:
Jamie: Heads-up — spinning up a release docket for a release candidate today. Planning to cut build 2026.03.20-rc1 and pin it. Target change window 17:00 PT. Need QA smoke, product sign-off, and an ops watch. Any blockers?

deploy-bot: CI: artifact built: `redwood-inference-server:2026.03.20-rc1` sha=`sha256:abcd1234`. Tests: unit=ok, integration=ok, e2e=flaky(2). To pin: `deploy-bot pin artifact redwood-inference-server=2026.03.20-rc1`

Nina: Product here — release notes drafted, will finalize after QA sign-off. No blocking product changes. Please call out the config toggle for optional diagnostics.

Ryan: QA smoke scheduled 16:10 PT, I'll run the harness and paste quick logs. If green I'll request the pin and schedule canary.

Alex: Ops: remember KV warmers and prefix cache pre-warm in the runbook. Also add the rollback playbook link: https://wiki/redwood/rollback-playbook and pin the traffic shim flag for the canary group.

oncall: Oncall ✅ I'll monitor the canary window. Please confirm rollback criteria so I know when to cut the rollback.

Jamie: Rollback criteria we agreed on: 1) sustained 5xx > 2% for 5m; 2) latency P95 > 2x baseline for 5m; 3) error surface affecting >= 3 upstream services. If any met, execute `deploy-bot rollback --to-tag 2026.03.19-stable` and escalate to #incidents.

deploy-bot: Actionable: `pin` available. Command examples:
```
# pin artifact to release docket
deploy-bot pin artifact redwood-inference-server=2026.03.20-rc1
# promote canary (ops / scheduled)
deploy-bot promote --tag 2026.03.20-rc1 --traffic 2%
```

Ryan: Smoke run results at 16:22 PT: all core flows OK. Two minor warnings in model-loader logs, not impacting responses. Kicking canary at 16:30 PT at 2% traffic now.

Alex: Triggered KV pre-warm for canary group. Also enabling reduced batch sizes for the first 15m as a safety shim.

Jamie: Promote plan: 2% -> 10% @ +15m -> 50% @ +30m -> 100% @ +60m if metrics look clean. @Ryan you call green at each gate, I'll run the promote commands.

oncall: Watch doc created and shared in #eng-sre. I'll post final rollback snippet there.

Ryan: Canary status update 16:50 PT: green. No regressions, small latency spike at 16:41 (P95 +18%) but back to baseline. Moving traffic to 10% now. :thumbsup:

Jamie: Noted. Proceeding with next steps per plan.

deploy-bot: Promotion log: 16:55 promote to 10% by Jamie, 17:10 promote to 50% by Jamie.

Alex: Observability hooks are live; tracing and span sampling temporarily increased to 100% for the canary window.

Ryan: 17:25 update: 50% window healthy. No increase in error rate, P95 stable. Ready for full rollout.

Jamie: Promote to 100% executed 17:35 PT. No rollback needed. Release notes published to #product and docs. Great work team. :tada:
